Fostering high-impact learning and discovery
Adelaide University’s academic and educational offerings are divided into six colleges and discipline-based schools, enabling high-impact learning and discovery that drives world progress.
Each college and its schools nurture students to become future leaders in their fields and inspire innovative researchers by connecting them to leading insights, resources and opportunities.
Adelaide University has six colleges:
College of Business and Law
College of Creative Arts, Design and Humanities
College of Education, Behavioural and Social Sciences
College of Engineering and Information Technology
College of Health
College of Science.
Our six colleges are made up of several schools that offer distinct teaching, learning and research opportunities. Our schools are dedicated to inspiring curiosity, fostering innovation and preparing students for meaningful careers. From the sciences and engineering to the arts, humanities, business, law, IT and health, every school offers expert guidance, hands-on learning, and opportunities that enable our people to make a lasting impact.
Find out more about our colleges and schools below, or visit Pathways College.
Our colleges and schools
College of Business and Law
This College fosters future leaders in business and law, equipping students with the knowledge and skills to navigate complex global challenges. Through industry partnerships and cutting-edge research, we drive innovation in legal and business education.
